detail.body:
## Motivation

MiniMax-M3 with an EAGLE3 draft does not start on CUDA. TARGET_VERIFY reaches the sparse layers' `forward_extend`, which
builds prefill metadata from `extend_seq_lens`. Verify batches carry none, so the startup warm-up's first TARGET_VERIFY
forward fails. On GB300 with `lmsysorg/sglang:nightly-dev-cu13-20261012-e6072935` and `Inferact/MiniMax-M3-EAGLE3-GQA`
(`--speculative-num-steps 3 --speculative-eagle-topk 1 --speculative-num-draft-tokens 4`, `SGLANG_DISABLE_MSA=1`):

```
  File "python/sglang/srt/layers/attention/minimax_sparse_backend.py", line 1504, in forward_extend
    cu_seqlens, seq_lens, prefix_lens = self._resolve_extend_meta(
  File "python/sglang/srt/layers/attention/minimax_sparse_backend.py", line 1425, in _resolve_extend_meta
    1, dtype=torch.int32, device=forward_batch.extend_seq_lens.device
AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'device'
```

#41497 fixed ROCm by running a linear draft chain through the unchanged sparse decode kernels, one causal row per draft
token. Every gate it added is `is_hip`, so CUDA still takes the prefill path.

## Modifications

- The linear-verify path of #41497 runs on every non-NPU GPU. `init_forward_metadata_in_graph` builds the per-row
  metadata (`seq_lens + arange(1..ndt)`, `req_pool_indices.repeat_interleave(ndt)`), and `forward_extend` hands verify to
  `forward_decode` on a shallow copy, so the dense layers keep their per-request metadata and the `bs * ndt` draft KV is
  stored once. `_init_rocm_linear_verify_metadata` becomes `_init_linear_verify_metadata`.
- The draft guard is `draft_is_chain_layout`, already used by the ROCm indexer CP: EAGLE chains (`topk == 1`) only, so
  tree drafts and other algorithms raise `NotImplementedError` at startup instead of running with chain lengths.
- Graph capture bound. On CUDA the TARGET_VERIFY capture took `_max_seqlen_k` from the 1-token dummy lengths, so the
  graph baked a one-column score buffer that `_decode_score_kernel` overruns at replay. Verify capture now takes the
  context-length bound on every platform, and the eager bound counts the draft rows (the last row reads `prefix + ndt`
  tokens, one more 128-token block whenever the window crosses a block boundary).
- Rows past the context length are clamped to it. They predict positions that are never committed (the scheduler caps
  `max_new_tokens` below the context length and trims over-accepted drafts), and the clamp keeps the verify bound at the
  context length instead of `context + ndt`. At 1M context that keeps the decode top-k in its 8192 register bucket: one
  extra block moves it to the 16384 bucket, measured at +3.3–3.9 µs per call at 4–128 rows and +22 µs at 512 rows on
  GB300 (57 sparse layers per step).
- Verify rows stay on the Triton kernels when MSA decode is enabled. The MSA plan is prepared for decode batches only, so
  with `--disable-cuda-graph` the rerouted rows would raise "MSA decode metadata missing". MSA with the decode graph and
  speculative decoding is still refused at startup, as before.

## Accuracy Tests

MiniMax-M3-NVFP4 on 4x GB300, TP4, `--context-length 1048576`, thinking enabled, `SGLANG_DISABLE_MSA=1`,
`lmsysorg/sglang:nightly-dev-cu13-20261012-e6072935` with this patch. EAGLE3: `Inferact/MiniMax-M3-EAGLE3-GQA`,
`--speculative-num-steps 3 --speculative-eagle-topk 1 --speculative-num-draft-tokens 4
--speculative-draft-model-quantization unquant`, real verification.

| same build, one tray each | no spec | EAGLE3 |
|---|---|---|
| GSM8K 1319 q (5-shot) | 0.861 | **0.864** |
| GSM8K 40 q at `--parallel 1` (bs=1 decode graph) | 0.800 | 0.875 |
| passkey retrieval at 131K / 524K / 990K prompt tokens | pass | pass |
| mean acceptance length (GSM8K / long-context probe) | – | 2.81 / 2.90 |

`test/registered/kernels/ops/attention/test_minimax_linear_verify.py` (new, CUDA) drives the backend's verify entry with a
stub KV pool and compares against the same rows decoded alone, on private copies of the cache that hold only the tokens
each row may see:
- eager verify of prefixes 1000 and 5118 (the second crosses a block boundary): bit-exact;
- a verify graph captured on 1-token dummies, replayed with one request two tokens short of a 64K context: rows inside
  the context match, rows past it are clamped;
- MSA decode is switched on in the fixture, so both cases also pin that verify rows run on Triton.

On GB300, dropping the draft-token term from the eager bound fails both eager cases (the rows that cross the block
boundary differ), and dropping the clamp fails both replay cases. `test_minimax_decode_topk.py` (160),
`test_minimax_decode_topk_page_table.py` (38) and `test_minimax_sparse_decode_paged_tile.py` (4) pass on GB300 with the
patch. The ROCm test only follows the rename.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Same build, one GB300 tray per arm, bs=1 decode right after the prompt is cached, 256 output tokens, real acceptance
(mean time per output token):

| prompt tokens | no spec | EAGLE3 | speedup |
|---|---|---|---|
| 8K | 4.34 ms | 2.23 ms | 1.95x |
| 131K | 6.00 ms | 3.40 ms | 1.76x |
| 524K | 9.78 ms | 5.43 ms | 1.80x |
| 990K | 13.88 ms | 8.30 ms | 1.67x |

`bench_serving` random 8K/1K, 16 concurrent, 64 prompts: output 1485 → 2387 tok/s (+61 %), median TPOT 9.31 → 5.53 ms.

AgentX results on GB300 (InferenceX methodology, EAGLE3 against no spec on the same build) will be added here when the
canonical sweep finishes.

## Not in this PR

- DP attention: `prepare_mlp_sync_batch` can still turn TARGET_VERIFY into one-token EXTEND rows, which this path does
  not see. TP is what this PR covers.
- Each draft row scores the index-K prefix on its own; a per-request packed scorer (as NPU's `pack_verify` and the ROCm
  indexer CP do) would cut verify indexer traffic at long context.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).

+"""MiniMax-M3 EAGLE verify on CUDA: each draft row must see exactly the prefix up to its own token,
+eagerly and when a graph captured on 1-token dummies replays at the end of the context.
+"""
+
+import sys
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.minimax_sparse_backend import (
+    MiniMaxSparseAttnBackend,
+)
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.minimax_sparse_ops.minimax_sparse import (
+    minimax_sparse_decode,
+)
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardMode
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=60, stage="base-b-kernel-unit", runner_config="1-gpu-large")
+
+# One TP4 rank of MiniMax-M3: 16 query heads, 1 KV head, 1 index head.
+NQH, NKH, NIH, HD = 16, 1, 1, 128
+BLK, TOPK, INIT_BLOCKS, LOCAL_BLOCKS, PAGE = 128, 16, 0, 1, 128
+NDT = 4
+MAX_CONTEXT = 64 * 1024
+# ReqToTokenPool width with speculative decoding: context + 4 + ndt.
+WIDTH = MAX_CONTEXT + 4 + NDT
+LAYER_ID = 3
+
+
+def _paged_req_to_token(num_reqs, first_page=0):
+    pages_per_req = (WIDTH + PAGE - 1) // PAGE
+    rows = []
+    for r in range(num_reqs):
+        base = first_page + r * pages_per_req
+        pages = torch.randperm(pages_per_req, device="cuda") + base
+        slots = pages[:, None] * PAGE + torch.arange(PAGE, device="cuda")
+        rows.append(slots.reshape(-1)[:WIDTH])
+    return torch.stack(rows).to(torch.int32), first_page + num_reqs * pages_per_req
+
+
+def _caches(num_slots, with_value):
+    nan = float("nan")
+    k = torch.full((num_slots, NKH, HD), nan, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+    v = torch.full_like(k, nan)
+    idx_k = torch.full((num_slots, 1, HD), nan, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+    idx_v = torch.full_like(idx_k, nan) if with_value else None
+    return k, v, idx_k, idx_v
+
+
+class _Pool:
+    """The slice of MiniMaxSparseKVPool that forward_decode touches."""
+
+    def __init__(self, k, v, idx_k, idx_v):
+        self.k, self.v, self.idx_k, self.idx_v = k, v, idx_k, idx_v
+
+    def set_fused_kv_index_buffer(self, layer, loc, k, v, idx_k, idx_v, *scales):
+        self.k[loc] = k.view(-1, *self.k.shape[1:])
+        self.v[loc] = v.view(-1, *self.v.shape[1:])
+        self.idx_k[loc] = idx_k.view(-1, *self.idx_k.shape[1:])
+        if idx_v is not None:
+            self.idx_v[loc] = idx_v.view(-1, *self.idx_v.shape[1:])
+
+    def get_kv_buffer(self, layer_id):
+        return self.k, self.v
+
+    def get_index_k_buffer(self, layer_id):
+        return self.idx_k
+
+    def get_index_kv_buffer(self, layer_id):
+        return self.idx_k, self.idx_v
+
+
+def _backend(req_to_token, pool, with_value):
+    b = MiniMaxSparseAttnBackend.__new__(MiniMaxSparseAttnBackend)
+    b.is_npu = False
+    b._linear_verify = True
+    b.speculative_num_draft_tokens = NDT
+    b.max_context_len = MAX_CONTEXT
+    b.req_to_token = req_to_token
+    b.kv_pool = pool
+    b.page_size = PAGE
+    b.block_size_k, b.topk_blocks = BLK, TOPK
+    b.init_blocks, b.local_blocks = INIT_BLOCKS, LOCAL_BLOCKS
+    b.score_type = "max"
+    b.disable_value_layer_ids = set() if with_value else {LAYER_ID}
+    b.use_dense_sparse_decode = False
+    # MSA decode on (no plan is built for verify): verify rows must still run on Triton.
+    b._use_msa_decode, b._msa_owns_decode = True, False
+    b._msa_dec_meta = None
+    b.fp8_attn_gemm = False
+    b.index_cache_enabled = False
+    b._decode_topk_buf = {}
+    b._topk_is_source = {}
+    b.hisparse_coordinator = None
+    b.indexer_cp = None
+    b._linear_verify_meta = None
+    b._prefill_seqblock_meta = None
+    b._max_seqlen_q = b._max_seqlen_k = 1
+    return b
+
+
+_LAYER = SimpleNamespace(
+    layer_id=LAYER_ID,
+    q_scale_float=None,
+    k_scale_float=None,
+    v_scale_float=None,
+    idx_q_scale_float=None,
+    idx_k_scale_float=None,
+    idx_v_scale_float=None,
+)
+
+
+class _Case:
+    """bs requests with given prefixes, their prefix KV, and ndt draft tokens each."""
+
+    def __init__(self, prefixes, with_value, seed=0):
+        torch.manual_seed(seed)
+        self.with_value = with_value
+        self.bs = len(prefixes)
+        self.prefix = torch.tensor(prefixes, dtype=torch.int64, device="cuda")
+        self.req_to_token, num_pages = _paged_req_to_token(self.bs)
+        self.pool = _Pool(*_caches(num_pages * PAGE, with_value))
+        rows = self.bs * NDT
+        self.q = torch.randn(rows, NQH, HD, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+        self.k = torch.randn(rows, NKH, HD, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+        self.v = torch.randn_like(self.k)
+        self.idx_q = torch.randn(rows, NIH, HD, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+        self.idx_k = torch.randn(rows, 1, HD, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+        self.idx_v = torch.randn_like(self.idx_k) if with_value else None
+        caches = [self.pool.k, self.pool.v, self.pool.idx_k, self.pool.idx_v]
+        for r, p in enumerate(prefixes):
+            slots = self.req_to_token[r, :p].long()
+            for cache in caches:
+                if cache is not None:
+                    cache[slots] = torch.randn(
+                        p, *cache.shape[1:], dtype=cache.dtype, device="cuda"
+                    )
+        draft_pos = self.prefix[:, None] + torch.arange(NDT, device="cuda")
+        self.out_cache_loc = (
+            self.req_to_token.gather(1, draft_pos).reshape(-1).to(torch.int64)
+        )
+
+    def batch(self):
+        return SimpleNamespace(
+            forward_mode=ForwardMode.TARGET_VERIFY,
+            seq_lens=self.prefix.clone(),
+            seq_lens_cpu=self.prefix.cpu(),
+            req_pool_indices=torch.arange(self.bs, dtype=torch.int64, device="cuda"),
+            out_cache_loc=self.out_cache_loc.clone(),
+            extend_seq_lens=None,
+            extend_seq_lens_cpu=None,
+            extend_prefix_lens=None,
+            minimax_m3_precached_sparse_layers=None,
+        )
+
+    def reference(self):
+        """Decode every draft row alone, on a copy that ends at its own token."""
+        rows = self.bs * NDT
+        ref_r2t, num_pages = _paged_req_to_token(rows)
+        k, v, idx_k, idx_v = _caches(num_pages * PAGE, self.with_value)
+        pairs = [
+            (k, self.pool.k, self.k),
+            (v, self.pool.v, self.v),
+            (idx_k, self.pool.idx_k, self.idx_k),
+            (idx_v, self.pool.idx_v, self.idx_v),
+        ]
+        seq_lens = []
+        for r in range(self.bs):
+            p = int(self.prefix[r])
+            for j in range(NDT):
+                row = r * NDT + j
+                dst_prefix = ref_r2t[row, :p].long()
+                dst_draft = ref_r2t[row, p : p + j + 1].long()
+                src = self.req_to_token[r, :p].long()
+                for dst, pool_cache, draft in pairs:
+                    if dst is None:
+                        continue
+                    dst[dst_prefix] = pool_cache[src]
+                    dst[dst_draft] = draft[r * NDT : row + 1].view(-1, *dst.shape[1:])
+                seq_lens.append(p + j + 1)
+        seq_lens = torch.tensor(seq_lens, dtype=torch.int64, device="cuda")
+        idx_o, o = minimax_sparse_decode(
+            self.q,
+            None,
+            k,
+            v,
+            self.idx_q,
+            None,
+            idx_k,
+            idx_v,
+            ref_r2t,
+            torch.arange(rows, dtype=torch.int64, device="cuda"),
+            seq_lens,
+            int(seq_lens.max()),
+            1,
+            BLK,
+            TOPK,
+            INIT_BLOCKS,
+            LOCAL_BLOCKS,
+            score_type="max",
+            disable_index_value=not self.with_value,
+            page_size=PAGE,
+        )
+        return (
+            None if idx_o is None else idx_o.reshape(rows, -1),
+            o.reshape(rows, -1),
+        )
+
+
+def _verify(backend, batch, q, k, v, idx_q, idx_k, idx_v):
+    backend.init_forward_metadata_in_graph(batch)
+    return backend.forward_extend(
+        q, k, v, _LAYER, batch, idx_q=idx_q, idx_k=idx_k, idx_v=idx_v
+    )
+
+
+def _assert_same(got, want, exact, rows=None):
+    for g, w in zip(got, want):
+        if w is None:
+            assert g is None
+            continue
+        assert not torch.isnan(g).any()
+        if rows is not None:
+            g, w = g[rows], w[rows]
+        if exact:
+            assert torch.equal(g, w)
+        else:
+            torch.testing.assert_close(g, w, atol=2e-2, rtol=2e-2)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("with_value", [False, True])
+def test_eager_verify_matches_causal_rows(with_value):
+    """Rows of one request share its cache yet see only their own prefix."""
+    # 5118 + ndt crosses into a new 128-token block, so the bound must count the drafts.
+    case = _Case([1000, 5118], with_value)
+    backend = _backend(case.req_to_token, case.pool, with_value)
+    batch = case.batch()
+    backend.init_forward_metadata_out_graph(batch)
+    assert backend._max_seqlen_k == 5118 + NDT
+    got = _verify(
+        backend,
+        batch,
+        case.q,
+        case.k,
+        case.v,
+        case.idx_q,
+        case.idx_k,
+        case.idx_v,
+    )
+    _assert_same(got, case.reference(), exact=True)
+    # Verify leaves the batch's per-request metadata to the dense layers.
+    assert batch.seq_lens.tolist() == [1000, 5118]
+    assert batch.extend_seq_lens is None
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("with_value", [False, True])
+def test_graph_replay_at_longer_context(with_value):
+    """A graph captured on 1-token dummies replays at the end of the context."""
+    # Request 0's last two rows run past MAX_CONTEXT: they are clamped, never committed.
+    case = _Case([MAX_CONTEXT - 2, 33000], with_value)
+    backend = _backend(case.req_to_token, case.pool, with_value)
+
+    static = case.batch()
+    static.seq_lens.fill_(1)  # get_cuda_graph_seq_len_fill_value()
+    static.seq_lens_cpu = static.seq_lens.cpu()
+    # Capture-time KV writes land in the free tail of each row.
+    static.out_cache_loc.copy_(
+        case.req_to_token[:, WIDTH - NDT :].reshape(-1).to(torch.int64)
+    )
+    inputs = [t.clone() for t in (case.q, case.k, case.v, case.idx_q, case.idx_k)]
+    inputs.append(None if case.idx_v is None else case.idx_v.clone())
+
+    backend.init_forward_metadata_out_graph(static, in_capture=True)
+    assert backend._max_seqlen_k == MAX_CONTEXT
+    _verify(backend, static, *inputs)  # warm-up: autotune and JIT compile
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+        out = _verify(backend, static, *inputs)
+
+    static.seq_lens.copy_(case.prefix)
+    static.out_cache_loc.copy_(case.out_cache_loc)
+    graph.replay()
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    # No row may read past the context-length bound the score buffer was sized for.
+    assert int(backend._linear_verify_meta.seq_lens.max()) == MAX_CONTEXT
+    # Compared to tolerance: the captured and the reference score buffers differ in width.
+    inside = [
+        r
+        for r in range(case.bs * NDT)
+        if int(case.prefix[r // NDT]) + r % NDT + 1 <= MAX_CONTEXT
+    ]
+    _assert_same(out, case.reference(), exact=False, rows=inside)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(pytest.main([__file__, "-v"]))
